name: Showcase Carousel
description: A carousel with the current slide forward and its neighbours turned away on either side.

props.name: slides
props.type: { title: string; src: string; alt?: string; action?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: The slides. The title is set over the image; the action, usually a small button, shows only on the current slide.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called when another slide comes forward.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the carousel for assistive technology.

props.name: labels
props.type: { previous?: string; next?: string; goTo?: (index) => string; slide?: (title, index, count) => string }
props.description: Text for assistive technology, for translation.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root, which fills its parent. Also accepts every other prop of a section.
